words_to_learn.en: may God strike (an affectionate/mock curse, my reading)

lines.en: God strike him, my dear, Naum,

lines.cyr: што ми стана Наум утро рано,
lines.lat: što mi stana Naum utro rano,
lines.en: who got up, Naum, early in the morning,
early in the morning, Naum, on Sunday.

lines.cyr: Па си јавна Наум брза коња,
lines.lat: Pa si javna Naum brza konja,
lines.en: And Naum mounted his swift horse,

lines.cyr: па си појде Наум в град Едеса.
lines.lat: pa si pojde Naum v grad Edesa.
lines.en: and Naum set off for the town of Edessa.

lines.cyr: На пат сретна Наум бела чешма,
lines.lat: Na pat sretna Naum bela češma,
lines.en: On the road Naum met a white fountain,
by the fountain, my dear, an old woman.

lines.cyr: - Ќе те прашам бабо да ми кажеш
lines.lat: - Ḱe te prašam babo da mi kažeš
lines.en: - I will ask you, granny, tell me

lines.cyr: дал' је жива бабо твојта внука.
lines.lat: dal' je živa babo tvojta vnuka.
lines.en: whether your granddaughter is alive, granny.

lines.cyr: Дал' је жива бабо твојта внука,
lines.lat: Dal' je živa babo tvojta vnuka,
lines.en: Whether your granddaughter is alive, granny,
- My granddaughter, son, has passed away,

lines.cyr: се посврши синко, в град Битола.
lines.lat: se posvrši sinko, v grad Bitola.
lines.en: she passed away, son, in the town of Bitola.

lines.cyr: Се посврши синко, в град Битола,
lines.lat: Se posvrši sinko, v grad Bitola,
lines.en: She passed away, son, in the town of Bitola,

lines.cyr: в град Битола синко, Баир маало.
lines.lat: v grad Bitola sinko, Bair maalo.
lines.en: in the town of Bitola, son, in Bair quarter.
